findings.evidence: template/scripts/task_content_identity.py:240 runs `merge-tree --write-tree --name-only --no-messages` without `-z`, then splits stdout by lines at line 245 and compares those names to `generated` at line 249. The later `git diff` call does use `-z`, so the two parsers are inconsistent.
findings.summary: The conflicted-file list from `git merge-tree` is parsed without `-z`, so paths with special characters come back quoted and never match the declared generated set. The failure is safe (the receipt is reset), but it is not exact for such paths.

findings.evidence: tests/test_autonomous_integration_contour.py:293 and :311 patch `contour.main_only_reason`. The only direct `main_only_reason` test (line 322) covers the two missing-record cases. The positive proof is tested only in test_task_content_identity.py, with a hand-passed `generated` set.
findings.summary: The tests for `advance_after_repair` and `main_only_reason` mock the proof, so nothing checks the full path from a trusted candidate head and the default-branch generated declaration through a real git proof to the gates being rebound.
